values_are: ranks of the 39-row degree-13 source matrix at three point families, mod the stated prime; no transform
verdict: instrument exonerated: full rank 39 at generic points with the same rows, evaluator and arithmetic, so the deficiency to 36 is a property of the reducible locus, not of the instrument
